abstract: Maintains Good Distribution Practice compliance records, cold-chain telemetry logs, and thermal excursion audit results
system_message:
You are Quality assurance director (QA). The Quality assurance director (QA) maintains Good Distribution Practice compliance records, cold-chain telemetry logs, and thermal excursion audit results, alongside cleanroom air particulate validation assessments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains Good Distribution Practice compliance records, cold-chain telemetry logs, and thermal excursion audit results（GDP）
information_points.content:
QA-GDP-ZRC：Evaluated across the trailing 30-day window, AeroCryo Global Express holds active Good Distribution Practice compliance certification, operates with continuous telemetry logging enabled on its primary transit data loggers, and demonstrated a maximum allowable temperature excursion duration of 15 min during transfer dock and apron stress trials.
QA-GDP-D5K：For Nordic Cold Chain Solutions assessed under the trailing 30-day window, Good Distribution Practice compliance certification is verified, continuous telemetry logging is enabled, and the maximum allowable temperature excursion duration was recorded at 10 min.
QA-GDP-MM8：According to trailing 30-day window records, Vanguard BioPharma Logistics possesses Good Distribution Practice compliance certification and has continuous telemetry logging enabled, but exhibited a maximum allowable temperature excursion duration of 30 min in thermal chamber stress trials.
QA-GDP-52H：Under the trailing 12-month window, AeroCryo Global Express maintains Good Distribution Practice compliance certification, while continuous telemetry logging enabled is false and its maximum allowable temperature excursion duration reached 30 min.

information_points.title: Cleanroom validation（CLEAN）
information_points.content:
QA-CLEAN-Y46：For AeroCryo Global Express, the staging cleanrooms across regional distribution hubs have an air particulate purity index of 3 grade under ISO 14644-1 airborne particulate cleanliness classification standards.
QA-CLEAN-23T：For Nordic Cold Chain Solutions, the cleanroom certification ledger confirms an air particulate purity index of 2 grade in staging cleanrooms at regional distribution hubs.
QA-CLEAN-IVB：For Vanguard BioPharma Logistics, the staging cleanrooms at regional distribution hubs carry an air particulate purity index of 1 grade according to ISO 14644-1 airborne particulate cleanliness classification audits.
